label: Clothing/Household
assignment: Discover realistic clothing and household-goods resources for people in {service_area} who cannot meet basic needs through ordinary retail. Follow relationships from coordinating organizations to the specific clothing closets, vouchers, furniture banks, household-goods programs, emergency replacement services, and work or school clothing people can actually access. Verify what is provided, eligibility, cost, schedules, inventory, service area, and pickup or delivery.
include: Free clothing closets, vouchers, seasonal clothing, shoes, and coats
Work, interview, school, maternity, infant, and other purpose-specific clothing
Furniture banks, beds, linens, kitchenware, appliances, and basic household goods
Emergency replacement after homelessness, fire, domestic violence, disaster, or relocation
Pickup, delivery, referral, appointment, sizing, frequency, and current-inventory realities
exclude: Ordinary clothing, thrift, furniture, appliance, or department stores without a hardship-access program
Donation drop-off locations that do not distribute goods to people in need
Online marketplaces or giveaways without a dependable program, safety boundary, and access process

sourceChannels: official nonprofit and faith-community program pages
school district, refugee, reentry, and domestic-violence providers
current local service guides only when they identify an operating provider

focuses.label: General clothing closets
focuses.direction: Find dependable programs that distribute free clothing, shoes, coats, or vouchers and verify schedule, referral, frequency, and service area.

focuses.label: Purpose-specific clothing
focuses.direction: Find direct programs for work, interviews, school, maternity, infants, veterans, refugees, or other needs where ordinary general closets may not suffice.

focuses.label: Furniture and household setup
focuses.direction: Find programs that place beds, furniture, linens, kitchenware, appliances, or complete household setups with clients; exclude donation-only operations.

focuses.label: Crisis and emergency replacement
focuses.direction: Find direct material help after homelessness, fire, disaster, domestic violence, foster placement, or sudden relocation.

focuses.label: Non-obvious embedded material assistance
focuses.direction: Look inside broader anti-poverty, disability, senior, immigrant, reentry, and family organizations for named clothing or household programs.
